questions.stem: How are sperm cells adapted for their function of reaching and fertilising the egg?

options.text: They have a large permanent vacuole for buoyancy
They have a tail for swimming, many mitochondria for energy, and a streamlined head
They have chloroplasts to produce their own energy source
They have a thick cell wall to protect them on the journey

questions.explanation: Sperm cells have a tail (flagellum) for swimming towards the egg, many mitochondria in the middle section to provide energy for movement, and a streamlined head to reduce resistance as they travel.
